REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
MONDAY - NOVEMBER 21, 2016 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

minutes_text:
MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
NOVEMBER 21, 2016, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL,
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Councilmember Jim Edwards.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Bella Caruso, Recreation Services Division
  “Joy of Singing” class member.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Carol Chen
  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Naresh Solanki
  Mayor/Chair George Ray

5.  Presentations/Appointments

  None.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Marty Grossman spoke about Commission stipends and benefits he has received
  in the past and City salary and benefit information from the Transparent
  California website.

  Gail Grossman expressed concerns about budget cuts, a proposed sales tax
  measure, and the Cerritos Astor museum.

  Marlene Rofe expressed concerns regarding the closure of the Cerritos Sheriff’s
  station.

  Jay Gray expressed concerns about the accuracy of information provided during
  public comments by Councilmembers and the public, budget allocations,
  Commission car allowances, and the Cerritos Astor museum.

  Anantha Narayanan stated that the items he mentions during the City Council
  meetings are based upon facts and research and suggested the Council should
  better communicate their decision making regarding the sales tax measure and
  recent cuts that were made to the budget.
 City of Cerritos  November 21, 2016

7.  Consent Calendar
  Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by
  one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a
  Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be
  removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

7A.  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Adjourned Regular Meeting and
  Special Meeting Minutes of November 7, 2016 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Pulido, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Adjourned Regular Meeting and Special Meeting
  Minutes of November 7, 2016 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The motion
  carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated November 21,
  2016 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Pulido, to approve the
  Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated November 21, 2016 in the
  amount of $4,975,962.24 (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the Successor Agency to the Cerritos
  Redevelopment Agency dated November 21, 2016 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Pulido, to approve the
  Register of Demands for the Successor Agency to the Cerritos Redevelopment
  Agency dated November 21, 2016 in the amount of $35,666.25 (SUCCESSOR
  AGENCY). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

  None.
 City of Cerritos  November 21, 2016
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 5

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of award of a contract for Citywide Water Feature
  Maintenance and Repair, Bid No. 1278-17 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kanna Vancheswaran, Director of Public Works.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Chen, and seconded by Edwards, to:

  1. Award a contract for Citywide Water Feature Maintenance and Repair in an
  amount not-to-exceed $142,000 annually, to Service First of Santa Ana,
  California for a one-year term with a provision of up to four (4) one-year
  extensions and reject the other bids; and
  2. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute any change orders
  necessary to complete water feature related maintenance and/or repair work
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9B.  Review and consideration of approval for expenditure of funds for the
  removal and replacement of five valves located on Bloomfield Avenue in the
  City of Cerritos (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Vince Brar, Senior Assistant City Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Chen, to:

  1. Make a finding that staff has negotiated a fair and reasonable cost for the
  installation of the four 16-inch valves and one 8-inch valve located on Bloomfield
  Avenue and in the vicinity of Towne Center Drive; and
  2. Approve the expenditure of funds in the amount of $15,670.50 to pay for the
  purchase of five valves and related hardware by the Water Division; and
  3. Approve the expenditure of funds in the amount of $70,278.00 to pay for the
  installation of five valves on Bloomfield Avenue in the City of Cerritos to Doty
  Bros. Equipment Company; and
  4. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute changes in the scope of
  work and related expenses if necessary (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  November 21, 2016
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 4 of 5

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9C.  Review and consideration of an agreement with Los Angeles County and the
  City of La Palma for the bridge preventative maintenance program, Project
  No. 13145 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kanna Vancheswaran, Director of Public Works.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Edwards, to

  1. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to approve and execute the
  Agreement with the County of Los Angeles for bridge preventative maintenance;
  and
  2. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to approve and execute the
  Agreement with the City of La Palma for bridge preventative maintenance
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9D.  Review and consideration of Cerritos Library policies for public computer use
  and internet access, wireless network, cardholder item check-out limits and
  access to patron records (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Annie Hylton, City Librarian and Marketing
  Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Edwards, to

  1. Approve the cardholder item check-out limits, Cerritos Library Waiver to allow
  access to patron records form, and Cerritos Library Cancellation of Waiver to
  allow access to patron records form; and
  2. Research fees and policies related to the Cerritos Library Public Computer Use
  and Internet Access Policy and Wireless Network Policy and report back to the
  City Council (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
